pages.title: Ring Of Spectral
pages.text: Step onto the other side of this world with this ghostly ring! As you cross over into the astral plane, the world around you turns into shimmering pearl and no living creature can see you anymore. Wander unseen past every danger and use the ring again to return. Crossing over consumes 15.0 somnium and staying on the other side costs 1.0 somnium every second.

pages.title: The Astral Plane
pages.text: On the other side no creature can harm you and you cannot harm any creature, as arrows and blows simply pass through. But beware, falling, lava and the void still hurt! Breaking blocks, placing blocks and opening chests is still possible, but every one of these actions drains extra somnium. When your somnium runs out, you are pulled back into the world.

pages.title: Crafting
pages.text: Long thought lost, the ring can be made again at the Arcane Workbench: a Ring of Invisibility in the middle, bound to the other side by Phantom Essence and Hollow Powder laid round it in turn. Very rarely a finished ring also waits in the caches of the Phantom Crate, chests guarded by a ring of dark dripstone.
